> Cloudflare opened a TCP connection to your origin, sent its request, and your application did not return a response before Cloudflare's read timeout expired.

Cloudflare's documentation puts that default at 100 seconds on the standard proxy, and only Enterprise plans can raise it. A 524 error is not about reachability the way a 522 is. The connection worked.
